_comment: All coordinates are PDF points, top-left origin, measured from sample_care_label_file_.pdf. y values are text BASELINES, relative to the top of the slot. Font sizes match the sample as drawn (Arial 4.74 / 10.44 = the 5pt / 11pt spec scaled ~0.945). For the exact nominal spec set arial_size=5, cm_size_font=11 and composition.font_size=5.
_extra_panels_comment: 'extra' panels (Front/Back Part 4, 5 ...) are not in the Pad templates; they are drawn only when a long Care Instructions text pushes the 'Produced by + address' block onto them, and only if they fit inside the Pad page width (Pad 1 fits Front 4 + Back 4, Pad 2 also Front 5).
_block_comment: The paragraph starting with composition.block_marker and everything after it (Produced by + importer addresses) is kept together in ONE panel: Front Part 3 (block_min_panel) or, if the Care Instructions text before it already reaches that panel, the next empty panel (Back 3, Front 4, ...).
_made_in_comment: The paragraph starting with composition.made_in_marker is anchored to the BOTTOM of the panel just before the 'Produced by' panel (e.g. bottom of Back Part 2 when Produced by is in Front Part 3). It needs made_gap_min_lines blank line(s) after the care text; if it does not fit, the Made-in/Produced-by pair moves one panel further.
_last_baseline_comment: Last allowed text baseline in a panel. 296.0 keeps text just above the pink dash guide at the bottom of the Back panels (Back panels = 49 lines, Front panels = 46).
_skupljanje_comment: The Skupljanje (shrinkage) line is tied to the 'Made in Bangladesh' paragraph: it sits skupljanje_gap_lines blank lines ABOVE it (3 -> Skupljanje is 4 lines above the first Made-in line). Set 4 for one more line of space. If there is no Made-in / Produced-by block, Skupljanje stays in the normal text flow.
_back_bottom_comment: Back panels: 'last_baseline' = lowest allowed text baseline. 282.2 keeps the text (incl. descenders) 5 mm above the pink dash line at the bottom of the Back panels (dash is at y=297.4 in the panel, 5 mm = 14.17 pt). Raise the number to let text go lower, lower it for a bigger gap. Front panels use composition.last_baseline.
